## A private journey through 3 regions of Brazil

In Rio, the programme centres on Corcovado, Sugar Loaf, the historic centre and a free day, which you can complement with a helicopter flight, tropical islands, culinary workshops, the Botanical Garden or trekking. At Iguazu, you will see the falls from both the Brazilian and Argentine sides. The final days are spent in Búzios, where you can choose between beaches, walks around town and time at sea.

The trip includes excursions with an English-speaking guide, transfers and high-class vehicles, except at the Iguazu Falls. In Rio, you can add VIP access to Sugar Loaf, Fast Track Gold, fine restaurants and other additional services.

The luxury aspect of the programme lies above all in the private arrangements: meeting and assistance, private transfers, a choice of restaurants, and the option to add Fast Track Gold, VIP access and private excursions. The natural highlights remain those that define a journey through Brazil: Corcovado and Sugar Loaf, both sides of Iguazu and the Atlantic coast of Búzios.
